task: Implement pretty donor leaderboard, recent-history, and member-history windows with canonical alt grouping.
resume_instruction: Extend Apcmanager #donor with: donor top (rank donors by all-time item count), donor last (latest 25 donations with absolute time and donor), and donor <member> (latest 10 plus all-time total). Combine active ledger.json items with archived history/history-*.jsonl item records and deduplicate stable item IDs. Resolve each donor and member argument through Manager's canonical alt mapping so alts aggregate under their main. Render human-readable AO blobs with clickable navigation. Preserve AP-members-only authorization. Static checks only; Kavey owns build/live test.
